name: analytic_admx_thesis_tab6_1
title: ADMX empty-cylinder mode frequencies (Braine PhD thesis Table 6.1)

software.code: closed form (Eq. 6.21); the thesis does not say whether the table is computed or measured, the caption says 'measurements of a single empty cavity' for run 2 / EFR

geometry.description: four empty right circular cylinders (closed, no rods, no ports)

ADMX Main.source: Table 6.1 (column header 'Radius'; caption: all lengths in cm)

ADMX Sidecar.source: Table 6.1 (column header 'Radius'; caption: all lengths in cm)

ADMX run 2.source: Table 6.1 (column header 'Radius'; caption: all lengths in cm)

ADMX EFR.source: Table 6.1 (column header 'Radius'; caption: all lengths in cm)

conditions.B0_direction: z (axial), for the C cross-check only

conventions.form_factor_definition: C = |int E.z dV|^2 / (V int |E|^2 dV) (not tabulated here; closed form 4/x0n^2 for TM0n0, 0 for TM0np p>=1)
conventions.notes: f = c/(2 pi) sqrt((x/R)^2 + (p pi/H)^2), x = j0n for TM0n, j'11 for TE11

analytic_check.method: closed form, c = 299792458 m/s, PEC; tabulated values are rounded to 2-4 significant figures

gaps.issue: caption says the run-2/EFR entries are 'measurements of a single empty cavity'; the main/Sidecar rows look computed. Precision is 2-4 significant figures only.
gaps.proposal: use as an analytic sanity check only; the axionFEM reference is the closed form (exact), the table is checked to its rounding

gaps.issue: Table 6.1 gives Sidecar R = 4.60 cm, H = 12.1 cm, but the Sidecar paper 1901.00920 quotes 0.064 m inner DIAMETER (R = 3.2 cm). The 4.60 cm row may be the later clamshell Sidecar cavity of the thesis.
gaps.proposal: take Table 6.1 numbers at face value (they are self-consistent with Eq. 6.21, see analytic_check); do not mix with 1901.00920

inconsistencies.description: Table 6.1 rounded entries vs closed form: ADMX Main TM010 0.547 vs 0.54639 GHz (+0.11%), TM011 0.567 vs 0.56619 (+0.14%), Sidecar TM010 2.50 vs 2.4944 (+0.22%). All CONSISTENT within rounding once the rounding of R is included (R = 21.0 cm -> +-0.24% on f; Sidecar R = 4.60 cm and f = 2.50 GHz -> +-0.31% combined). Earlier text called these 'beyond rounding'.
inconsistencies.evidence: Table 6.1 vs Eq. 6.21 with the tabulated (rounded) R, H
inconsistencies.proposal: no inconsistency; closed form is the reference, table values are rounded sanity checks

solver_class.reason: empty closed cylinder: TM0np exactly axisymmetric (m=0); TE111 is an m=1 azimuthal mode, reachable with an azimuthal-order-m 2D formulation or as a 3D cross-check

priority_reason: closed-form, exact, 2D axisymmetric; first regression test
